items.title: Craft or Scrap a Melee Weapon
items.detail: Scrap any melee weapon at a workbench or craft one at a weapons workbench

items.title: Catch a Fish
items.detail: Fish at any water source; Fisherman's Rest in The Mire is a reliable location

items.title: Cook Grilled Fish
items.detail: Requires Grilled Fish recipe plan; craft at cooking station with 3 Fish Bits, 2 Salt, 1 Wood

items.title: Kill a Blood Eagle
items.detail: Fast travel to Dagger's Den for reliable spawns of Blood Eagles

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during an Infestation
items.detail: Find Infestations on map as gray cloudy areas; Phantoms spawn during this event

items.title: Sell a Shotgun to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Sell any shotgun to any NPC vendor; Whitespring Resort has multiple vendors

items.title: Take a Camera Picture at the Starlight Drive-In
items.detail: Fast travel to Starlight Drive-In in Burning Springs, equip camera and take a photo

items.title: Build a Decoration in a Shelter
items.detail: Enter your C.A.M.P. shelter and place any decoration from the build menu

items.title: Catch a Fish
items.detail: Fish at any water source deep enough to fish

items.title: Collect RadAway or Rad-X
items.detail: Collect from world loot or craft diluted versions at a chemistry station

items.title: Collect Soap
items.detail: Find at Whitespring Resort in showers or behind main building; or collect from Games Cupboard

items.title: Collect a Board Game
items.detail: Take from Games Cupboard at your C.A.M.P. if you have one placed

items.title: Eat a Vegetable
items.detail: Harvest and eat any raw vegetable like Tato, Corn, or Razorgrain

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during a Daily Operation!
items.detail: Enter Daily Ops and kill Pint-Sized Phantoms; they are the enemy during Slasher event

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during an Infestation
items.detail: Find Phantoms in Infestation areas marked on your map

events.name: Mutated Public Events
events.description: All public events have a chance to spawn as mutated variants with bonus rewards.

events.name: Double SCORE Weekend and Murmrgh's Special Pick
events.description: Earn double SCORE from challenges and Murmrgh offers a special legendary weapon mod rotation.

events.name: Slasher C.A.M.P. Contest
events.description: Compete in a building contest themed around the Slasher seasonal event for community recognition.

events.name: Mischief Night
events.description: Seasonal Halloween-themed event featuring Pint-Sized Phantoms and exclusive rewards.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: Halloween-themed event with special scorched variants and spooky seasonal rewards.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run Weekend
events.description: Increased chance to catch seasonal fish varieties during this special weekend event.
